description: Fund an existing pending_deposit bounty. Always call with dryRun=true first: the preview returns the amount, platform fee, total, and current wallet balance without charging anything. Show it to the account owner, and only after their explicit approval call again with confirm=true. A confirmed call may reserve available wallet funds immediately. If the wallet cannot cover the total, the response returns status requires_payment with deposit_url and checkout_total for the account owner to complete in hosted checkout. Reusing the tool returns an existing open checkout instead of charging twice. Unknown arguments are rejected. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the pending_deposit bounty to fund

confirm.description: Must be true to fund. Set it only after showing the dryRun preview to the account owner and receiving their explicit approval.

dryRun.description: true returns a no-charge preview: amount, platform fee, total, and current wallet balance. Nothing is reserved, charged, or started.

name: fund_bounty
title: Fund bounty
